entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Shri Ashish
Gupta - Advocate for the appellant.

Heard on I.A.No. 9770/2025 which is first application under section 430 of Bnss for suspension of
sentence and grant of bail on behalf of sole appellant-Sachin.

2.  The appellant has been convicted under Sections 366-A, 376(3), 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code and sec. 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act and sentenced to undergo 5 years RI with fine of Rs.2000/-, 20 years RI with fine of Rs.2000/- and 20 years RI with fine of Rs.2,000/- with default stipulation.
3.
The allegation against the appellant is that he had abducted the minor girl and committed rape with her.
4. Counsel for the appellant submits that prosecutrix and all other witnesses including her father and mother have not supported the prosecution case and turned hostile.
The age of prosecutrix as per scholar register was 12 years 4 months and 21 days on the date of incident.
The appellant is in jail since 16.5.2024 and final hearing of the appeal is likely to take time.
5. Counsel for the State opposed the prayer and submitted that age of prosecutrix has been found to be less than 14 years on the date of incident and apart from that DNA is positive.

2 CRA-245-2025 6. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the there is delay of 7 days in lodging the FIR, the prosecutrix and her parents have turned hostile, in the MLC nothing has been found to be positive and thus, the conviction is based only on the DNA report coupled with the fact that appellant is a young man aged 21 years and is behind the bars since 16.5.2025 and final hearing of the appeal is likely to take sufficient long time, prima facie we are of the opinion that the present application deserves to be allowed.

With the aforesaid, I.A is allowed and disposed of.
